entries.title: Ezekiel 27:1
segments: The word of the LORD came to me, saying,

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:2
segments: And you, son of man, take up a mourning for Tyre.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:3
segments: And say to Tyre, O you who are placed at the entrance of the sea, a merchant of the peoples for many coastlands, so says the Lord Jehovah: O Tyre, you have said, I [am] of perfect beauty.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:4
segments: Your borders [are] in the midst of the seas, your builders have perfected your beauty.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:5
segments: They have made all your [ship] boards of fir trees of Senir; they have taken cedars from Lebanon to make masts for you.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:6
segments: They have made the oaks [of] Bashan your oars; the daughter of Assyria has made your deck of ivory from the coasts of Kittim.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:7
segments: Your sale was of fine linen with embroidered work from Egypt, an ensign for you; violet and purple from the coasts of Elishah was your covering.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:8
segments: The residents of Sidon and Arvad were your seamen. Your wise ones, O Tyre, were in you, they [were] your sailors.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:9
segments: The elders of Gebal and her wise [men] were with you, reinforcing your seams. All the ships of the sea with their seamen were with you, to exchange your merchandise.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:10
segments: Persia and Lud and Lydia were in your army, your men of war. They hung the shield and helmet in you; they set your splendor.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:11
segments: The sons of Arvad and your army [were] on your walls all around, and warriors [were] in your towers. They hung their shields on your walls all around; they have made your beauty perfect.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:12
segments: Tarshish [was] your merchant because of the multitude of [your] wealth; with silver, iron, tin, and lead, they gave for your wares.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:13
segments: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech [were] your merchants. They traded the souls of men and vessels of bronze for your goods.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:14
segments: From the house of Togarmah they gave horses and war-horses and mules for your wares.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:15
segments: The sons of Dedan [were] your merchants; many coastlands [were] the traffic of your hand. They brought as your gift tusks of ivory and ebony.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:16
segments: Syria [was] your merchant because of the multitude of your works; with emeralds, purple, and embroidered work, and fine linen, and coral, and rubies they gave for your wares.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:17
segments: Judah and the land of Israel [were] your merchants with wheat [from] Minnith and Pannag, and honey, and oil, and balm, they gave for your goods.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:18
segments: Damascus [was] your merchant in the multitude of your works, from the multitude of all riches, in the wine of Helbon, and white wool.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:19
segments: Dan and Javan also, going about, gave for your wares; smooth iron, cassia, and cane were among your goods.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:20
segments: Dedan [was] your merchant in loose cloths for riding.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:21
segments: Arabia, and all the rulers of Kedar [were] traders of your hand, in lambs, and rams, and goats; in them [was] your trade.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:22
segments: The merchants of Sheba and Raamah [were] your merchants, with the chief of all the spices, and with every precious stone, and gold they gave for your wares.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:23
segments: Haran, and Canneh, and Eden, the merchants of Sheba, Asshur, Chilmad [were] your merchants.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:24
segments: They [were] your merchants in perfect things, in violet cloth, and embroidered work, and in carpets of many colors, with tightly bound cords, and cedars among your merchandise.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:25
segments: The ships of Tarshish [were] the travelers of your goods. And you were filled and made very glorious in the heart of the seas.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:26
segments: Your rowers have made you come into great waters; the east wind has broken you in the heart of the seas.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:27
segments: Your riches, and your wares, your goods, your seamen, and your sailors reinforcing your seams, and the traders of your goods, and all your men of war, who [are] in you, and all your company which [is] in your midst, shall fall into the heart of the seas in the day of your ruin.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:28
segments: At the sound of the cry of your sailors the open lands will shake.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:29
segments: And all who handle the oar, the mariners, all the sailors of the sea, shall come down from their ships. They shall stand on the land,

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:30
segments: and shall cause their voice to be heard against you, and shall cry bitterly, and shall throw dust on their heads. They shall wallow themselves in the ashes.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:31
segments: And they will be bald for you, and gird with sackcloth. And they shall weep for you with bitterness of soul, a bitter wailing.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:32
segments: And in their wailing they shall lift up a lamentation [and] lament over you, [saying], Who [is] like Tyre; as she who is quiet in the midst of the sea?

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:33
segments: When your goods went out from the seas, you filled many people. With the plenty of your riches and your goods you enriched the kings of the earth.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:34
segments: At [this time] you are broken by the seas, in the depths of the waters, your goods and all your company in your midst have fallen.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:35
segments: All the residents of the coastlands are appalled at you, and their kings are horribly terrified; [their] faces tremble.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:36
segments: The merchants among the peoples hiss at you; you have become terrors. And you [shall] not [be] forever.
